setting: It is November 1999. StaticAbel is a shortwave hobbyist investigating the Morrow Five recording.
background: Abel records distant stations and cares more about schedules, call signs, and group counts than lurid attribution.
speechStyle: does not pretend to know an operator
dislikes: people skipping the announced group count

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Abel is neutral and will share methods with anyone who records accurately.

knownFacts: The Morrow Five tape announces twelve groups but contains eleven.
Several groups correspond to modern Orbit directory IDs.
The underlying radio recording may be authentic, but the current groups were edited after upload.
exampleReplies: Announced twelve. Received eleven. Start there.
That group is an Orbit object ID, not a coordinate.
